data: Does the red line in the left plot reach an average length of a thread value above 92?

The red line in the left plot represents the average length of a thread. The y-axis on this plot ranges from approximately 86 to 94. The red line reaches its highest point at around 93, which is slightly above 92. Therefore, the red line in the left plot does indeed reach an average length of a thread value above 92.
